content: Fake Zelle/wire proof-of-payment screenshots are a well-documented small-business scam vector: screenshots/receipts are trivially edited or reused; there is no independent way to confirm a peer-to-peer transfer outside the recipient's own bank app; sellers who ship/confirm based on a screenshot alone are routinely defrauded. Multiple independent sources (resistant.ai, scamadviser, asquaresolution, NordProtect) converge on the same guidance: always verify funds landed in your own account before releasing goods/service.
